content.comment_body: I need assistance with [product_name] software, as I am required to program some features using the Memento blocks. When running the simulation mode (with [product_name] not connected to my PC), I notice these blocks remain active and do not reset after each new simulation. I searched the program help but did not find relevant information. Is there a way to reset all Memento blocks in the program using blocks, or does connecting [product_name] to the PC alter this simulation behavior? Apologies for my English. Regards

Hello [user_name], If I understand correctly, in actual setups, pushbuttons are used instead of switches. For simulation, you can right-click on the input and select 'Block properties > Simulation > Momentary pushbutton' to mimic this behavior. Does this address your question?

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered issues with Memento block states persisting in simulation mode while using [product_name] programming software. The primary concern is the lack of an option to automatically reset or clear these blocks upon restarting simulations, resulting in confusion during program testing. The user found the included help documentation insufficient, revealing a gap in guidance for this functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for a method to reset all Memento blocks during simulation, either with built-in software functions or by emulating hardware interactions. They also expect more thorough documentation or instructions to clarify this behavior.
